name: keepwatching
title_zh: 9:16 竖屏完播率实测库，选题先查再拍
tagline_zh: 别赌爆款。每个模板都带真实留存曲线和样本量，从选题到渲染成 MP4 一条龙，A/B 两个版本直接出片对比。
tagline_en: Stop guessing. Every format ships with measured retention & sample size. Pick, render 9:16 MP4s, A/B test—all.
desc_en: Use when producing, planning, or critiquing short-form vertical video (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) — choosing a format for a topic, rendering a 9:16 MP4 from a JSON spec, running an A/B test between two formats, or reading retention numbers back into a decision. Provides a library of named formats with measured retention and sample sizes, a deterministic Node + Playwright + ffmpeg renderer, and a CSV-b
why_zh: 把「感觉会火」换成「数据说留到第 3 秒」——留存数字反哺决策，渲染器确定性复现，不靠剪辑手感碰运气。
why_en: Turns 'feels viral' into 'retention at second 3'. Deterministic Node+Playwright+ffmpeg pipeline, so your A/B test isn't polluted.
limit_zh: 只认竖屏短视频（TikTok/Reels/Shorts）；需要本机装 Node。
limit_en: Vertical short-form only. Requires local Node, Playwright, ffmpeg. Outputs MP4 + retention CSV; no platform upload, no landscape conversion.
title_en: 9:16 retention-tested formats, check before you shoot
